note: Bets EVERY original spread grade (grading.py v1) A+ offer to verify the grade on 2026 lines. Basis: output/research/grade_v2_spread.md, 'Grade v1 (production use)' rows (scripts/research/grade_v2_spread.py v1_eval): 2023-25 v1 A+ CLV +2.20% +- 1.34 (p 0.0496), 49 bets (~16/season) -- BORDERLINE; dev 2020-22 +2.97% +- 1.24 on 49. The v1 points scheme was never fit to data, but 2023-25 was the holdout of earlier studies, so the 2026 season is the clean test. Do not edit to fit results; bump version instead.
grade: grading.grade('spread', ...) exactly as spread_bets.evaluate calls it (blend-EV points, model-vs-market gap, line move since first seen, side of 3/7, QB-change flag): A+ = score >= 4

qualify.candidate: copied from v1_eval: at ANY snapshot (no injury-report / QB-confirmed eligibility; the research applied v1 to every snapshot), take the allowed-book (my_books.json) offer with the highest blend EV among offers passing the research spread filter, and bet it if its v1 grade is A+
qualify.quote_filters: research sp_ok (ml_spread_consistency.build_ml): both prices -145..+125, home point = -away point, half points, point within 2.5 of the median valid point of all books at the snapshot (Pinnacle/exchanges left out, as in the research feed), overround -1%..12%
qualify.window_note: research candidate table: snapshots 10 min .. 7 days before kickoff
qualify.lock: One bet per game at the FIRST snapshot where the game's best offer is A+, at that offer's book and price; later snapshots never change it. Snapshots = every full run (pipeline update) AND every hourly odds watch (pipeline watch). The research looked only at our historical run times (sparser), so more looks can only find more A+ moments: expect somewhat more bets than the research rate and judge the result on 2026 lines.
qualify.known_differences: the research set the QB-change flag to False (the historical flag would leak the actual starter); live the flag is applied as in production, which can only turn an A+ into an A

validation.clv_definition: spread_bets.grade: EV of our point and price under the closing market's price-implied expected margin from our own last pre-kickoff odds snapshot (closing_margins, prices included; never spread_line alone)
